description: This file defines utility classes and templates for input validation, including ExpectedValues, Validator, and ValidationManager, within the Utils namespace. It includes mechanisms for expected value validation, custom validation functions, and validator management.

classes.name: ExpectedValues
classes.description: Template class for managing expected values of type T, supporting discrete sets, ranges, and regex-based validation.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Template class for validating values of type T, supporting expected values and custom functions.

classes.name: ValidationManager
classes.description: Class managing multiple validators, allowing addition, validation, and logging of validation results.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a value against expected values, range, or regex.

methods.name: addValidator
methods.description: Adds a validator to the ValidationManager by name, supporting expected values or custom functions.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets a logging function for validation messages.
